title: Senior Designer
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.

This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.

You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.

You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone.

What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.

  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.

  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.

  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.

  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.

  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.

  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.

Requirements

Hard Skills:

  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)

  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.

  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.

  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.

  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.

  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.

  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite

  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS
description:
Descrição da vaga

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI ́s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aquelesdanificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foiretirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao AuxiliarAdministrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação daintegridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradase saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando aoAdministrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc.,informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilhafeita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial osproblemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança doscolaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes,definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização daatividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física doscolaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentesnos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresaresponsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos,exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores;Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações;
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Jornada: escala 12x36 (diurno ou noturno)

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Atividades na área Logística;
  • Atividades em empresas com grau de risco (3 ou 4)
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica (extensivo aos dependente diretos).
  • Alimentação no local
  • Vale transporte
  • Convênio Farmácia: desconto em medicamentos e produtos diversos para higiene pessoal

Para sua saúde e bem-estar:

  • GymPass / Seguro de Vida.

Para seu desenvolvimento acadêmico:

  • Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.

Sobre a empresa

A Triunfo Logística oferece soluções competitivas em operação portuária e logística com altos padrões de qualidade, segurança, ética e respeito ao meio ambiente, buscando gerar valor para acionistas e sociedade. Tem como objetivo ser referência nacional no setor portuário e marítimo, promovendo logística integrada e tornando-se a maior operadora multi-purpose do Brasil. Atua com ética, transparência e foco na segurança, valorizando o trabalho em equipe, a gestão por resultados, a performance, a iniciativa e a integridade. A empresa acredita na inovação como meio de alcançar resultados diferenciados e demonstra paixão e orgulho pelo que faz, entregando excelência a clientes e colaboradores.

description:
HSE Advisor - Occupational Safety Technician

RINA is currently recruiting for a HSE Advisor - Occupational Safety Technician to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the RINA Consulting QOHSE Division.

Mission

A Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Advisor typically plays a crucial role in supporting the HSE function within an organization. The role supports the application of the Corporate and Company policies, developing and implementing security policies, guidelines, procedures, and protocols for the security of Company assets, projects, and business travels.

Key Accountabilities

  • Compliance Monitoring: ensure that the organization complies with local, state, and federal health and safety regulations; monitor and track changes in regulations and update relevant stakeholders.
  • Risk Assessment: assist in conducting risk assessments to identify potential hazards in the workplace; collaborate with other departments to analyze and mitigate risks.
  • Training and Education: support the development and delivery of HSE training programs for employees; help create educational materials to promote awareness of health and safety issues.
  • Incident Investigation: participate in investigations of accidents, incidents, or near‑misses to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences; assist in the documentation of incidents and implementation of corrective actions.
  • Data Analysis: collect and analyze HSE data to identify trends and areas for improvement; prepare reports on HSE performance and make recommendations based on the analysis.
  • Emergency Response Planning: contribute to the development and testing of emergency response plans; assist in organizing drills and training exercises for emergency situations.
  • Inspections and Audits: support regular inspections and audits to ensure compliance with HSE policies and procedures; document findings and work with relevant teams to address any deficiencies.
  • Communication: assist in the communication of HSE policies and procedures to employees; participate in HSE meetings and collaborate with other departments to promote a culture of safety.
  • Documentation and Record Keeping: maintain accurate and up‑to‑date records related to HSE activities; assist in preparing documentation for regulatory agencies and internal audits.
  • Continuous Improvement: identify opportunities for continuous improvement in HSE processes and procedures; stay informed about industry best practices and incorporate relevant updates into the HSE program.

Qualifications

  • Technical degree in occupational safety is mandatory, along with registration with the Ministry of Labor and Employment. Bachelor's degree is a plus.
  • Good experience in HSE advisory roles, preferably in industrial or construction sectors.
  • Having certifications related to health and safety can enhance a candidate's profile, including ISO 45001.
  • Familiarity with local, state, and federal health and safety regulations is crucial.
  • Ability to analyze data and identify trends related to health, safety, and environmental performance.
  • Experience in conducting risk assessments, safety audits, and ensuring compliance with local and international standards.
  • Proficient in developing and delivering HSE training and awareness programs.

Competencies

  • CLIENT INTIMACY – Embrace internal and external client needs, expectations, and requirements to ensure maximum satisfaction.
  • EARN TRUST – Take everyone's opinion into account and remain open to diversity.
  • PROMOTE SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT – Promote commitment by keeping promises as a role model.
  • MANAGE EMOTIONS – Recognise one's and other's emotions and express and regulate one's reactions.
  • PIONEER CHANGE – Actively embrace change and benefit from the new circumstances.
  • BUILD NETWORK – Forge trust relationships, across departments, and outside the organization.
  • MAKE EFFECTIVE DECISIONS – Structure activities according to priorities, actions, resources, and constraints.
  • ADDRESS THE WAY – Have a big picture of different situations and reinterpret it in a perspective way.
  • THINK FORWARD – Capitalise on experiences and translate them into action plans for the future.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Isso só se consegue com pessoas dedicadas e com uma mente curiosa. A curiosidade está na origem das grandes ideias. E as grandes ideias fomentam o progresso.

E hoje convidamos você, mente curiosa, para fazer parte da nossa equipe na Alfa Laval Aalborg, em Petrópolis-RJ, como Técnico de Planejamento de Manutenção

Quem você é

Você é um profissional orientado para o cliente e para resultados, com forte compromisso com a qualidade na execução das suas atividades. Demonstra excelente capacidade analítica, comunicação eficaz e habilidade para construir relacionamentos interpessoais. É comprometido, engajado e atua de forma proativa para alcançar os objetivos.

Sobre o trabalho

Você irá prestar suporte técnico e elaborar orçamentos na área Assistência Técnica. As atividades diárias incluem:

  • Executar e acompanhar os planos de manutenção.
  • Organização e cadastro de máquinas e equipamento no sistema de manutenção;
  • Planejamento e controle de atividades dos colaboradores da manutenção ;
  • Levantamento de dados e indicadores de manutenção;
  • Desenvolver melhorias para os processos, visando redução de custos, otimização das etapas e menor tempo de realização e redução de paradas não planejadas de máquinas e equipamentos;
  • Desenvolver fornecedores e prestadores de serviço;
  • Realizar treinamento operacional conforme demanda;
  • Desenvolver processos, criar e aperfeiçoar procedimentos de manutenção;
  • Relatar problemas e anomalidades detectadas em máquinas e equipamentos;
  • Fornecer suporte para reparos emergenciais/não programados em equipamentos de produção durante a operação.
  • Preparar propostas orçamentária de compra de peças e serviços para manutenção.
  • Abrir e enviar requisiços de compras para aprovação do gestor.
  • Fazer folow up com fornecedores e setor de compras quanto ao recebimento de peças de manutenção para reparo.

title: Estágio em Qualidade & HSE - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Estágio em Qualidade & HSE - Rio de Janeiro

Você gostaria da oportunidade de estagiar em uma empresa Global de Energia e Tecnologia? Você gosta de embarcar em projetos desafiadores? Venha fazer parte do nosso Programa de Estágio!

Previsão de Início: Março 2026

O nosso Estágio é pensado para permitir que estudantes de Nível Superior tenham a oportunidade de ter experiências práticas de trabalho, formando uma base sólida para suas vidas profissionais. Nossos estágios lhe darão percepções de primeira mão sobre os processos, sistemas e práticas que estão alinhados para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas por meio de execução impecável e aplicação de tecnologia de ponta.

Esteja ao lado dos melhores! Nosso Estágio vai te proporcionar a oportunidade de participar em Treinamentos técnicos e de desenvolvimento, reuniões de equipe e participar de projetos para apresentar seus resultados. Durante seu estágio, você terá todo suporte da equipe, gestão e um Buddy designado especialmente para suas necessidades, garantindo que você tenha uma experiência de aprendizado valiosa.

Essa é uma oportunidade para desenvolver competências em mapeamento de processos, análise de hábitos de usuários e proposição de melhorias por meio de sistemas e ferramentas digitais. Durante o programa, você atuará junto ao time global de QMS, apoiando o desenvolvimento de procedimentos e acompanhando ações que impactam diretamente a eficiência e a qualidade em projetos estratégicos. Suas atividades envolverão a colaboração na criação de procedimentos com o time global de QMS, o acompanhamento de planos de ação e indicadores de qualidade, além do aprendizado e suporte em atividades relacionadas às normas internacionais de qualidade e suas aplicações práticas dentro da empresa. Também fará parte das suas responsabilidades o mapeamento de processos e a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria, bem como o apoio no desenvolvimento de ferramentas e sistemas voltados para a área de Qualidade.

Como estagiário, você será responsável por:
  • Receber treinamento e mentoria, que permitirão que você complete suas tarefas e projetos que aperfeiçoarão seu aprendizado e habilidades;
  • Engajar, conhecer e aprender sobre sua área designada, mas não limitando-se à;
  • Participar e Entregar projetos internos para entregar resultados aos clientes (internos e externos) e identificar oportunidades de melhorias no negócio e área;
  • Aprender o Sistema Operacional interno (incluindo softwares e aplicativos) que lhe ajudarão no processo de desenvolver e entregar seus projetos e tarefas diárias;
  • Colaborar e Conectar com diferentes times, estagiários e áreas da Baker Hughes para ter um amplo conhecimento e rede de networking global;
  • Aplicar os conceitos de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio-Ambiente) garantindo e mantendo os procedimentos em todas as situações para um ambiente mais seguro, íntegro e saudável;
  • Participar e Engajar em grupos de integração para estagiários e outros Hubs de voluntariado, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão que alavancarão seu networking e desenvolvimentos de habilidades por todo o Globo.
Para ter sucesso e ser considerado no nosso estágio, você precisa:
  • Estar regularmente matriculado em cursos de Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica e correlatas) ou Administração;
  • Possuir Inglês de nível Intermediário para Avançado;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em ferramentas Microsoft 365 (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint);
  • Ter disponibilidade para estagiar pelo período de 02 anos, 30h por semana;
  • Possuir o direito de estagiar legalmente no Brasil;
  • Perfil analítico e atenção aos detalhes. Proatividade e curiosidade para aprender novas ferramentas;
  • Comunicação clara e eficaz para lidar com equipes multidisciplinares e diferentes nacionalidades;
  • Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas de forma estruturada.
Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação:
  • Qualidade e HSE: O estagiário da área de Qualidade & HSE terá diferentes oportunidades de explorar seus conhecimentos dentro da área que for designado.
  • Qualidade de Projetos: O estágio em Qualidade de Projetos é uma ótima oportunidade para desenvolver habilidades relacionadas a mapeamento de processos, observar e entender hábitos de usuários e, com isso, propor desenvolvimento de sistemas e ferramentas digitais para o setor da Qualidade e demais áreas de interação que irão fazer a diferença no dia a dia das pessoas.
  • Qualidade de Manufatura: Suportar as atividades atribuídas ao time de melhoria contínua, atuando na gestão dos indicadores e melhoria dos processos, além de apoio no tratamento de NCRs de serviço, aplicando métodos de análise e solução de problemas, auditorias, e processos de Revisão da Gestão da Qualidade.
  • HSE (Health, Safety, Environment): Prestar suporte ao Departamento de HSE na área de meio ambiente nos processos de medição e monitoramento de indicadores ambientais e de atendimento às condicionantes das licenças, bem como auxiliar na implementação de programas corporativos relacionados à redução do consumo de CO2, auxiliar treinamentos e eventos de HSE, auxiliar a implementação e manutenção de iniciativas relacionadas a HSE digital e eficiência energética, auxiliar a tradução de documentos e procedimentos, e auxiliar no processo de retirada e gestão de resíduos.

Localização

Confira a localização da vaga no momento da sua candidatura, já que temos diferentes escritórios espalhados entre as cidades do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Bahia.

Formas de Trabalho

Na Baker Hughes, temos diferentes ambientes de trabalho, que dependem da localização e área de atuação. Sendo um estágio, os Modelos Presencial e Híbrido são as melhores opções, focando em um desenvolvimento mais amplo, diverso e rodeado de oportunidades para networking.

description:
Rigger Soldador Offshore - Subsea (Embarcado)

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão à além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

  • Preparar equipamentos, acessórios, consumíveis de soldagem e corte e peças a serem soldadas.

Tecnologia e inovação fazem parte das nossas raízes. Jogamos junto de escolas e famílias no desafio de educar em um dia-a-dia ultraconectado.

Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de auxiliar de serviços de loja . buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa , bom de gente e bom de jogo .

quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? vem pra FARM!

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
About Us

At MetaCTO, we specialize in helping startups and growing companies turn visionary ideas into successful digital products through expert app development and fractional CTO services. As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of the backend infrastructure that powers innovative applications for our clients. This role will involve managing cloud environments, optimizing databases, automating deployments, and improving system observability.

Job Description

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at MetaCTO, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining highly available, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions. You will collaborate with software engineers to improve system performance, automate operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of critical backend services. You’ll work extensively with cloud platforms like AWS, leveraging technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines to enhance system reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS (Lambda, EC2, RDS, S3, EKS, SQS, CloudWatch).
  • Manage and optimize databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) for performance, reliability, and security.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure system health and performance, with specific experience using Zabbix and Elastic Logging.
  • Design and maintain CI / CD pipelines for automated deployment and scaling of applications.
  • Work with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Develop and enforce security best practices for cloud environments and infrastructure.
  • Automate operational processes using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and scripting languages like Python or Bash.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related incidents and optimize system performance.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable system design, with a strong focus on Django-based applications.

Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Strong expertise in AWS cloud services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront, EKS, SQS, IAM).
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS, or EKS).
  • Deep knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), including performance tuning, query optimization, monitoring, and migration management.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Strong experience with CI / CD pipelines and automation tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or GitLab CI / CD).
  • Proficiency in monitoring tools, specifically Zabbix, and logging solutions like Elastic Logging.
  • Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or Go for automating operational tasks.
  • Experience working with Django-based applications in a cloud environment.
  • Experience implementing security best practices for cloud-based applications.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and microservices architecture.

Preferred Skills

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Experience with serverless computing and event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with message queue services (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Understanding of zero-downtime deployments and disaster recovery strategies.

Position Details

  • Type: Full‑Time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Hours: US Pacific Time hours

How to Apply

If you are passionate about scalability, automation, and reliability, and thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and an optional brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

MetaCTO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name : Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group (

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves : is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted : treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you : wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different : we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model : you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product's modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position :

Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.

Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.

Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.

Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.

Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.

Champion a hands‑on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first‑hand customer / user insights.

Create a culture of decision‑making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.

Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)

Experience on B2B SaaS scale‑ups

Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth

A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers

Expertise in the end‑to‑end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices

An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills

Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit

Analytical abilities and problem‑solving skills

Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must

Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus

Hands‑on : In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000 and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits :

100% remote-friendly within Brazil

Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;

We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);

Food / Market Voucher ;

Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;

Pet Plan;

iFeel app , for emotional comfort;

Gympass for you and up to 3 people!

Creditas : Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;

Stock Options - eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period) -

Birthday Day Off;

Daycare Assistance;

Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;

Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;

Leave of Absence / Time‑off : in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Important : Docplanner is an international English‑first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

About The Project

We’re supporting a US homeowner who wants to redesign and expand their existing home. The project includes modifying current layouts, extending structural areas, adding new rooms, adjusting rooflines, and producing 2D/3D plans to visualize the new design before submission to a US-licensed professional. Your job is to redesign, model, and prepare architectural drawings, and later a Texas‑licensed professional will take those drawings and submit them for permitting.

Role Summary

You will take the homeowner’s ideas (videos, measurements, sketches, existing blueprints) and convert them into professional architectural redesigns. Your deliverables will include updated floor plans, elevations, sections, and 3D models that clearly show how the redesigned spaces will look and function. The Texas‑licensed engineer/architect will later use your plans for code compliance, stamping, and permitting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing layout and homeowner‑provided videos describing the redesign vision.

  • Prepare a "plan set" that a US‑licensed professional can finalize, validate, and stamp for permitting.

Requirements

Must‑Have

    • AutoCAD

Soft Skills

  • Strong spatial and architectural design intuition

Sobre a Organização

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

title: Senior Partnership Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has created a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Partnership Manager will be responsible for managing and delivering FIFA’s commercial partner rights at the local level, ensuring seamless coordination with the global FIFA Partnership Management team in Zurich. This includes day-to-day relationship management, operational delivery at venues and events where required, and strategic alignment with partner objectives within the host country and region.

Key responsibilities

  • Proactively lead and foster relationships with FIFA Commercial Partners operating in Brazil, ensuring consistent, high-quality servicing in line with global standards.
  • Act as the key local point of contact for assigned Commercial Partner, ensuring continuous alignment and close collaboration with the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich to maintain consistent servicing and delivery across all touchpoints.
  • Lead assigned partnership projects and deliverables related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ in Brazil, ensuring on-time, in-scope, and on-budget execution while identifying meaningful, locally relevant business and marketing opportunities that enhance partner impact and remain aligned with FIFA’s global partnership and brand strategy.
  • Project lead for assigned local partner activations and FIFA-related events in Brazil (e.g. Local Commercial Partner Workshops).
  • Ensure local partner activations and brand visibility adhere to FIFA’s third‑party regulations and brand protection standards, working in close coordination with the Commercial Legal and Brand teams.
  • Track and manage local partner budgets and support reconciliation processes in close coordination with the Zurich Partnerships team.
  • Prepare and lead meetings and updates with internal and external stakeholders, including regular reporting to the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich.
  • Provide solution‑oriented, proactive support to the Head of Commercial Partnerships in Brazil and contribute to a unified servicing approach across global and local workstreams.
  • Support continuous improvement by feeding local market insights and operational learnings into FIFA’s global partnership tools and client servicing frameworks.

Your profile

  • University degree required, preferably in Business, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field
  • A solid understanding of the business of sports, marketing, and sponsorship rights delivery
  • Project and event management experience, ideally in an international environment
  • Working knowledge of digital and social media is an advantage
  • 6–8 years of experience in brand marketing, sponsorship, or client servicing in the sports or entertainment industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
  • Experience working in or with international organizations and global brands
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian market and local executional landscape is a strong asset
  • Client-oriented with strong interpersonal and written communication skills
  • Efficient and effective time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to define priorities, lead projects independently, and provide direction to junior team members when required
  • Team-oriented, service-minded, and collaborative across functions
  • Strategic and creative problem‑solver with a hands‑on mindset
  • Comfortable working under pressure, managing multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability
  • High level of professionalism, empathy, and commercial awareness
  • Strong representation skills, both internally and externally
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

title: Engineer II
description:
Join to apply for the Engineer II role at ABS Group

Job Description

Performs engineering design review and analysis assignments normally involving a major project or several smaller or less complex projects. These projects, by their complexity and difficulty, require the competent application of mechanical engineering knowledge and conventional engineering practices. The incumbent will develop a strong understanding of company policies, methods, and procedures through broader and technically challenging assignments.

What You Will Do

  • With minimal or no supervision performs detailed engineering review of plans, as assigned, for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations and contract commitments.
  • Perform detailed engineering review of mechanical systems and designs for compliance with applicable international standards, Brazilian NRs, local authority requirements, and ABS Group methodologies.
  • Conduct inspections and Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) for piping, pressure vessels, and pressure valves, considering API 579 Fitness-for-Service analysis and other regulatory standards.
  • Provide support and technical solutions for Marine and Offshore assets and refinery facilities.
  • Analyze and resolve design conflicts and propose innovative solutions to moderately complex engineering problems.
  • Draft accurate and timely technical reports, responses to communications, and formal documentation.
  • Communicate project status and workload effectively to ensure client needs are met.
  • Work independently or in a team environment and interact with clients to identify and resolve technical challenges.
  • Implement and maintain ABS Group Quality System requirements after completing Quality System training.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • B.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering or another related discipline.
  • Professional/Chartered Engineer License.
  • Certification as Person Habilitated (PH) in Brazil under CREA standards.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Demonstrated understanding and ability to apply fundamental classification and quality concepts, practices and procedures.
  • Demonstrated understanding and ability to apply advanced mechanical engineering concepts, practices, and standards.
  • Knowledge of Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) techniques, including API 579 Fitness-for-Service analysis.
  • Proficiency in CAESAR II (pipe stress analysis) and familiarity with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) tools is advantageous.
  • Solid problem-solving skills with the ability to propose technical solutions to engineering challenges.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work well independently or collaboratively with others in a team.
  • Strong computer literacy, including the use of engineering analysis software.
  • Five (5) years minimum of relevant mechanical engineering experience in a design office, consulting company, or energy industry-related projects.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

Professional or chartered engineer license.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports to a senior level engineer or technical manager. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

  • Create motion graphics and video content to enhance storytelling and brand communication.
  • Conduct user research and gather feedback to refine designs, ensuring alignment with end‑user expectations and business objectives.
  • Formulate and drive the internal visual design strategy to ensure excellence and cohesion across all creative outputs.
  • Handle complex use cases involving large‑scale audiences and multiple interdependencies.
  • Iterate designs based on data insights, feedback, and emerging trends to enhance brand visibility and user engagement.

  • Act as a bridge between business goals and design execution.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional experience with a portfolio showcasing branding expertise, visual strategy, motion graphics, and versatility across mediums.

  • Proven track record of delivering pixel‑perfect end‑to‑end designs, including motion graphics and video editing, that align with brand strategy.
  • Strong understanding of large‑scale branding projects, including complex use cases involving millions of users or substantial financial impact.
  • Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and motion/video editing tools like After Effects or Premiere Pro.
  • Key traits: Professionalism, problem‑solving ability, proactiveness, attention to detail, and a passion for visual storytelling.

Preferred Skills

  • Ability to identify and set trends in visual design to maintain brand relevance and impact.
  • Experience working with data‑driven design processes and conducting user research.
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies and collaborating in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong communication skills to present and justify design decisions effectively.

This is a unique opportunity to leave a lasting impact on our branding efforts and contribute to meaningful, large‑scale projects. If you’re a designer with a passion for Branding and a proven ability to deliver exceptional results, we’d love to hear from you!

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates must be based in Latin America (LATAM) to ensure effective collaboration with the team's schedule.

title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands-on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high-quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English are essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full-time position based in our training centre in Rio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Instructional Design: Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e-learning solutions
  • Instructional Design: Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e-learning and blended learning products which are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards
  • Instructional Design: Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e-learning experiences which align with Maersk Training’s standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and coach a team of instructional designers and e-learning developers.
  • Team Leadership: Assign and oversee tasks, providing guidance and constructive feedback to ensure quality and consistency of products.
  • Team Leadership: Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team culture.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct performance reviews and support team members’ professional development.
  • Project Management: Manage multiple e-learning projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, timeline, and budget.
  • Project Management: Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Project Management: Work closely with the existing Digital Content Team and L&D Managers in the development of learning products.
  • Project Management: Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Project Management: Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Project Management: Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • Project Management: The confidence to balance competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We are looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in instructional design/e-learning development, including 3–4 years in team leadership or project management.
  • Proven success managing cross-functional teams and complex e-learning projects.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

Estamos em busca de um PMO Pleno para atuar como pilar estrutural da governança, garantindo cadência, integridade metodológica, organização documental e consistência no acompanhamento dos workstreams. Esse profissional será essencial para sustentar a execução integrada dos projetos de Backoffice, IS-U, Dados, Integrações e Cutover.

Faça parte do nosso time e ajude a Bee Vale a continuar entregando inovação, flexibilidade e crescimento no mercado de benefícios corporativos.

Se você é dinâmico(a), apaixonado(a) por solucionar problemas, e gostaria de atuar em um ambiente colaborativo no qual as equipes trabalham de forma integrada, essa oportunidade é para você.

Principal Objetivo

Garantir a satisfação e fidelização dos clientes por meio de um atendimento ágil e eficaz, ao mesmo tempo em que será peça-chave na execução de iniciativas que aprofundem o engajamento e o relacionamento entre a Bee Vale, nossos clientes e seus colaboradores.

Suas Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atendimento reativo e resolutivo, garantindo suporte rápido e eficiente a dúvidas e problemas técnicos.
  • Gerenciamento de tickets e interface com áreas especializadas, sempre buscando solucionar as “dores” dos clientes.

Nosso Perfil Ideal

  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente ou suporte técnico.
  • Noções ou experiência prévia com tarefas de Customer Success Management (CSM) serão um diferencial (gestão de relacionamento, upsell/cross-sell, planos de ação para retenção de clientes).

title: Analista de Suporte N2 - Redes
description:
Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável, resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3.

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade: testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio); identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar): verificar potência RX/TX das ONUs, ONUs flutuantes (online/offline) e erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP: sessões PPPoE travadas; cliente autenticando e não navegando; cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução.

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes.
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE.
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping, tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em pelo menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT, BNG e BRAS.
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6.
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada em provedor de internet, com habilidade em resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão e gerenciamento de plantões.

  • Elaborar os procedimentos aplicáveis à sua função, bem como o Regulamento interno da Escola para sua aprovação e implementação.
  • Definir os Programas de interação entre a Escola Rocca e os pais ou mentores dos alunos.

Características do perfil

  • Contar com experiência na aplicação de testes psicométricos e na implementação de estratégias que ajudem a corrigir situações encontradas neles.
  • Contar com competências de informática para o manuseio de dados, informações e relatórios.

title: Power Electronics Developer
description:
Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description
  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.
You are meant for this job if:
  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Exciting global R&D environment.
  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • State-of-the-art development environment.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Business Developer - Last Mile Partners, AMZL EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider)

Do you want to work hard, have fun and make history? If you do then Amazon could be the right career choice for you. Our logistics teams are changing the way we interact with customers around the globe every single day and solving some of the biggest logistical challenges facing not just Amazon, but also the entire industry.

Amazon’s transportation teams work to ensure the delivery packages globally for customers around the world. Whether its items large or small, we find solutions to make sure we are delivering on our promise for customers.

Amazon’s Transportation Operations team is seeking for an EDSP Business Developer to join our Brazil Transportation team. EDSPs are External Delivery Service Providers that means third-party operated Delivery Station which uses Amazon tools and technology to deliver Amazon packages different regions of the country. There are currently 38 operational nodes of EDSPs in Brazil operated by 5 different partners and 2024 plan is to reach 92 nodes with ate least 10 different partners. The EDSP Business Developer is responsible for hunting new partners and following the onboarding process until the new EDSPs are launched. We expect our team members to identify ways to improve our operations continually.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage the onboarding process of new EDSPs until its launch.
  • Partner with Purchasing and Program Management Teams on the identification and development of potential new partners, looking for new opportunities of volume increase and cost reduction for AMZL.
  • Partner with PMO on the launches’ planning per task and stakeholder, assuring the committed timing and cost.
  • Work on continuous improvement initiatives, including benchmarks with other geos.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Logistics and Transportation.
  • Experience in Project Management.
